arms.difference: ONLY the pory2 field. Same MAG and DODUO (gen5), k 4x4, depth 0, 1 reserved switch row, budgetMs 1000.

It is NOT the 14 s ladder clock; that is stated, not hidden.

command: cmd.exe /c tools\lownode.cmd solver/machamp/sprt.js --release eaa5becc54eb --x solver/porygon2/v2/gen5-p2v2.json --y solver/machamp/league/gen5.json --elo0 0 --elo1 20 --alpha 0.05 --beta 0.05 --max-games 2000 --seed 30002 --workers 3 --cap 50 --info honest --team-store C:/Users/willj/Projects/Pokemon/ABRA/data/team-pool-frozen-regmc --out solver/out/sprt-pikl-v2/sprt2-p2v2-vs-gen5.json
order: starts only after SPRT 1 (preregistration-sprt1-pikl.json) has stopped: one game-playing job at a time.

reading_rule.when: ONCE, after sprt.js stops (a bound crossed or the game budget spent). sprt.js prints no interim LLR; nothing is read before the stop. A run stopped by anything else (a pause, a crash, a kill) is VOID and is re-run from this file with the same seed.
reading_rule.verdict: sprt.js verdict: H1 (X stronger by elo1 accepted), H0 (elo0 accepted), or INCONCLUSIVE (2,000 games, no bound).
reading_rule.clock: solver/machamp/sprt_read.js: clock ratio = clock.x_ms.mean / clock.y_ms.mean over the counted games; must be <= 1.10. Above 1.10 an H1 is NOT a strength claim and is reported as VOID-BY-CLOCK.
reading_rule.capability: the v2 leaf must prove it ran, from each worker's last shard line summed: ctr.leaf_own['porygon2-v2-k1.json'].evals > 0 with errors = 0, equal to ctr.leaf_by_model['porygon2-v2-k1.json'], and ctr.leaf_by_model['porygon2-gen5.json'] > 0 (Y on its own net). Any of these false = VOID.
reading_rule.errors: errored pairs are excluded by sprt.js and counted; VOID if they exceed 5% of the pairs used. Agent fallbacks and MILTANK prior fallbacks are read and stated.
reading_rule.also_read_not_bars: per-arm leaf calls (the cost of v2 at equal clock), the Protect counters (solver/arena/protect_read.js), the ladder clock-rule breaches. None decides the verdict.
reading_rule.ci_caption: the Wilson 95% interval at the stop is conditional on a data-dependent stopping time and slightly optimistic.

on_H1: report only. v2 goes onto no ladder arm and no league default; that is Will's call even on H1. An H1 here does not retro-pass gate (a).
on_H0_or_inconclusive: report only; v2 stays off every arm.
